svg.title: Kneeling worker lifting by hand - facing left
svg.desc: Worker facing left, kneeling on one knee and leaning forward with both gloved hands extended to lift. Helmet, full-body harness, work clothes and safety boots. Worker only, no tools or background.
svg.metadata: id: W010 name_ja: 片膝立ち起こし作業員（左向き） file: worker_kneeling_lifting_left.svg category: 作業員 view: three-quarter front, facing left tool: none source: user-provided reference image repository: Ryujiiwaizumi/construction-pictograms
